name: Brick Volume Addressing with If-Else
definition: A method to address samples in a brick-structured volume. It computes offsets for neighborhood access (resampling or gradient). It uses an if-else statement to check if all needed samples are within the current brick; if true, it uses linear addressing, otherwise it calls ComputeOffset for each neighbor.
summary: Brick Volume Addressing with If-Else computes memory offsets for brick-structured volumes by using conditional checks to apply fast linear addressing within a brick or fallback calculations across bricks, differing from lookup table methods by avoiding table memory overhead at the cost of pipeline flush penalties.
